first_error_behavior: Validate and Save stop at the first ordered rejection. Validate contains an earlier silent no-quarter return that makes its later Item 3 alert unreachable.

rules.condition: A monetary field handled by blockletter is blank, nonnumeric, or negative on blur.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Nonnumeric and negative values are silently replaced with 0.00; numeric values are rounded with binary parseFloat().toFixed(2).
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Reject malformed or negative values explicitly and use decimal arithmetic.

rules.condition: A whole-number field handled by blockletterWithout2Decimal loses focus.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Nonnumeric input is cleared; numeric input is rounded with toFixed(0).
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Reject invalid values explicitly and document rounding.

rules.condition: A payment date is malformed or later than the current date.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please provide a valid date. (MM/DD/YYYY format)
rules.official_behavior: Malformed dates are cleared with the format alert; future dates are cleared with `This date cannot be a future date.`
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply calendar-valid MM/DD/YYYY parsing and the same future-date boundary.

rules.condition: A numeric key filter receives a second decimal point or malformed pasted value.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: The package permits multiple dots during key entry; blur later coerces malformed text to 0.00.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Permit at most one decimal separator and validate pasted/programmatic values.

rules.condition: Calendar-year mode is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Month is forced to 12 and disabled; the two-digit year is cleared.

rules.condition: Fiscal-year mode is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Month is cleared and enabled; the two-digit year is cleared.

rules.condition: validateYear runs while no quarter is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: The function returns silently before applying year-range checks.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Report the missing quarter and validate year independently of quarter selection.

rules.condition: validateYear detects a future fiscal quarter.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: The change handler returns silently, whereas final Validate shows `Future filing is not allowed.` for the same boundary.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use one shared predicate and one explicit message.

rules.condition: validateFiscalMonth compares the four-digit input year with Date.getYear().
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Date (Page 1 Item 2) cannot be greater than current date when filing for Fiscal Year.
rules.official_behavior: Date.getYear() returns years since 1900, so ordinary four-digit input years always satisfy inputYear > currentYear; current/future-month logic is applied under the wrong year comparison.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use getFullYear() and compare a complete year-month value.

rules.condition: Other-ATC checkbox is cleared.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: The ATC select is cleared and disabled.

rules.condition: An ATC selection changes.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Schedule 1A-only, Schedule 1B-only, or combined Schedules 1-4 are enabled according to the exact ATC switch.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Represent the switch as revision-scoped ATC metadata.

rules.condition: A rate-bearing ATC is selected for any August, or for July 2020.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Because `CreateYear == 2020 && CreateMonth == 07 || CreateMonth == 08` lacks parentheses, every August in every year enables a manual 0.00 rate.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Parenthesize the 2020 month condition and bind rates to effective periods.

rules.condition: Amended Return No is selected for a combined regular-rate ATC.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Schedule 4 Item 6 is reset to 0.00 and disabled.

rules.condition: Two-digit year is blank or nonnumeric.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Invalid year entered. Please provide a valid year.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Fiscal/calendar year-end month is blank or nonnumeric.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please provide a valid fiscal year-end month.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: No quarter is selected during the preliminary selectedQuarter branch.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.official_behavior: Validate returns silently before reaching its later explicit missing-quarter alert.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Show `Please select Quarter in Item 3.` and do not silently return.

rules.condition: Calendar-year input is earlier than 2018.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Year (Page 1 Item 2) should not be earlier than January 2018.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Calendar-year input is later than the current year.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Year (Page 1 Item 2) cannot be greater than the current year for Calendar Year.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Fiscal-year input is earlier than 2018.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Year (Page 1 Item 2) should not be earlier than January 2018.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Selected fiscal quarter end is later than the current date.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Future filing is not allowed.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Month or year is blank after the preliminary checks.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Date on Item 2.
rules.official_behavior: This branch is unreachable for blank/nonnumeric values because earlier checks already return.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Consolidate date validation into one reachable rule.

rules.condition: No quarter is selected at the explicit Item 3 check.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select Quarter in Item 3.
rules.official_behavior: This message is unreachable because the preliminary selectedQuarter branch returns silently first.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Move this message to the preliminary branch.

rules.condition: Neither MCIT nor other ATC checkbox is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select ATC on Item 5.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Other ATC is checked but the ATC select is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select ATC on Item 5
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Any TIN core segment or branch code is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: A TIN core segment is not exactly three characters or branch code is shorter than three.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: Length is checked but no TIN checksum is invoked; branch length 3-5 is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Validate the official TIN checksum and exact revision-appropriate branch shape.

rules.condition: RDO value loosely equals numeric zero.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 7.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Taxpayer name is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Taxpayer Name on Item 8.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Registered address is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Taxpayer's Registered Address on Item 9.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: ZIP code is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Zip Code on Item 9A.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: First DOM occurrence of contact number is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter Contact Number on Item 10.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Neither deduction method is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select Method of Deductions on Item 12.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: Tax relief Yes is selected but Item 13A is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please specify Special Law/International Tax Treaty on Item 13A.
rules.official_behavior: The ordered Validate branch rejects the condition.

rules.condition: A Schedule 4 Item 6 description is nonblank but its amount equals exactly 0.00.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please input Other Tax Credits/Payments amount on Schedule 4 Item 6
rules.official_behavior: Only exact string 0.00 is rejected; equivalent zero spellings can bypass the rule.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Compare parsed decimal value to zero.

rules.condition: A Schedule 4 Item 6 description is blank but its amount is not exactly 0.00.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please specify Other Tax Credits/Payments on Schedule 4 Item 6
rules.official_behavior: The check is string-based rather than decimal-value-based.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Compare parsed decimal value and normalized description.

rules.condition: No quarter is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please select quarter in Item 3.
rules.official_behavior: Save stops before serialization.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the same preflight and preserve the exact distinction from full Validate.

rules.condition: A TIN core segment or branch code is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: Save checks only nonblank TIN parts, not length or checksum.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Reuse full identity validation before saving.

rules.condition: RDO code is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid RDO Code on Item 7.
rules.official_behavior: Save rejects blank but not placeholder numeric zero, unlike Validate.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use the same RDO predicate for Save and Validate.

rules.condition: Taxpayer name is blank.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Official processing applies the documented rejection or mutation.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Taxpayer Name on Item 8.
rules.official_behavior: Save stops before serialization.
